name: onion
sowing_season: Kharif: June–July | Rabi: October–November | Summer: January–February
harvest_season: Kharif: Oct–Nov | Rabi: March–April | Summer: April–May
soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam, pH 6.0–7.5. Avoid waterlogged soils.

stages.name: Nursery / Seedling
stages.description: Seeds sown in nursery. Seedlings raised before transplanting.
stages.irrigation: Light sprinkler irrigation twice daily. Keep nursery moist but not waterlogged.
stages.fertilizer: Apply FYM 2 kg per square metre in nursery bed. Basal dose DAP 2 g/sq metre.
tips: Transplant when seedlings are 15 cm tall (25–30 days old)

stages.name: Transplanting / Establishment
stages.description: Seedlings transplanted to main field. Roots establishing.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate immediately after transplanting. Then every 4–5 days.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 40 kg DAP + 20 kg MOP per acre. Top dress 20 kg Urea at 20 days after transplanting.
tips: Transplant in evening to reduce moisture stress

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Rapid leaf and pseudostem growth. Bulb initiation begins.
stages.irrigation: Irrigate every 6–8 days. Critical period for bulb initiation.
stages.fertilizer: Second top dress: 20 kg Urea at 45 days after transplanting.
tips: Thrips can reduce yield by 50% — monitor regularly
Spray Spinosad 0.3 ml/litre for thrips control

stages.name: Bulb Development
stages.description: Bulbs swell rapidly. Leaves begin to fall over at neck.
stages.irrigation: Regular irrigation every 7–10 days. Avoid excess water — causes bulb rot.
stages.fertilizer: No nitrogen after this stage — excess N delays maturity and reduces storability.
tips: Reduce irrigation frequency as bulbs mature
Do not apply Urea now — causes soft bulbs that rot in storage

stages.name: Maturity
stages.description: 50% of tops fall over — harvest signal. Bulbs fully formed.
stages.irrigation: Stop irrigation 10 days before harvest to toughen the skin.
watch_for: Delay in harvesting causes neck rot and sprouting
tips: Cure harvested bulbs in shade for 7–10 days before storage

common_pests.name: Thrips
common_pests.symptoms: Silver streaks on leaves, distorted growth

common_pests.name: Onion fly (maggot)
common_pests.symptoms: Plants wilt, maggots visible in bulb

common_diseases.name: Purple Blotch
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions turning purple-brown on leaves

common_diseases.name: Stemphylium Blight
common_diseases.symptoms: Small yellow to tan lesions with purple border

common_diseases.name: Basal Rot (Fusarium)
common_diseases.symptoms: Yellowing from base, white fungal growth at roots
common_diseases.control: Trichoderma viride soil application, Carbendazim drench
